title: Machine Learning and Micro Capture-C resolve GWAS associations revealing endothelial stress pathways in Coronary Artery Disease
authors: Baxter M; Sanders E; Riva SG; Hamley JC; Gur ER; Dalgleish JLT; Freund IM; Roberts N; Raymond G; Sergeant M; Downes DJ; Li H; McVey DG; Ye S; Grace C; Hentges LD; Dujardin G; Webb TR; Davies JOJ; Kyriakou T; Goel A; Watkins H; Hughes JR
one_liner_zh: 该文结合Transformer机器学习与Micro Capture-C解析冠心病非编码变异，预测因果变异并识别转录因子结合基序破坏，虽聚焦疾病遗传学但核心涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Resolving the gene targets of non-coding genetic variation is the major bottleneck in translating genome wide association studies into mechanistic understanding of complex diseases such as coronary artery disease (CAD). Combining new Transformer-based Machine Learning (ML) approaches trained on cardiovascular epigenetics with high-resolution, allele-specific genomic and transcriptomic technologies we create a highly scalable platform to simultaneously resolve causal variants, cell-type of action, output gene, and direction of effect. When applied to CAD genetics, our ML predicts causal variants from 20,747 candidate SNPs across 9 vessel cell-types and identifies disrupted transcription factor binding motifs using ML feature attributions. We investigate 94 of the top predictions in endothelial cells using Micro Capture-C, revealing the importance of fluid shear stress and TGF-β signaling pathways. We exploit allelic skew in heterozygous cells to demonstrate both variant causality and effect direction, demonstrating this platform can be used to rapidly resolve non-coding genetics in complex disease.
abstract_zh: 解析非编码遗传变异的目标基因，是将全基因组关联研究转化为对冠状动脉疾病（CAD）等复杂疾病机制理解的主要瓶颈。通过将基于Transformer的新型机器学习（ML）方法（训练于心血管表观遗传学数据）与高分辨率、等位基因特异性的基因组和转录组技术相结合，我们构建了一个高度可扩展的平台，可同时解析因果变异、作用细胞类型、输出基因及效应方向。应用于CAD遗传学时，我们的ML模型从9种血管细胞类型中的20,747个候选单核苷酸多态性（SNP）中预测因果变异，并利用ML特征归因识别被破坏的转录因子结合基序。我们使用Micro Capture-C技术在内皮细胞中研究了94个顶级预测，揭示了流体剪切应力和TGF-β信号通路的重要性。我们利用杂合细胞中的等位基因偏斜来证明变异的因果性及效应方向，表明该平台可用于快速解析复杂疾病中的非编码遗传学。
